description: A long-lived deployment: a set of compute contracts, each declared with the state its author wants. Any client of the account may change the declaration; the socialweb-computer requester that runs the deployment writes the status. When the deployment ends its record is kept with status.endedAt.

contracts.description: The declared contracts. Names are unique within the record.

index.description: Only at rkey self: the account's index of live deployments. A record with index is not a deployment.

name.description: A DNS-1123 label, unique within the deployment.

state.description: staged: declared, no RFP is sent. requested: the requester runs the RFP flow and holds the guest. released: the guest is released.

releaseRequestedAt.description: With state released: the time of the newest release request; a newer one asks a failed release again.

userData.description: cloud-init user_data; never a secret, it is public here.

computeKind.description: What the bidder runs: a firecracker virtual machine (the default when absent), or a deno sandbox that runs spec.userData as its program.

net.description: computeKind deno: the program reaches the public internet; a bidder runs it only for its owner.

cpus.description: vCPUs of the VM (unset: the requester's default, 2).

mem.description: Memory of the VM, such as 8G (unset: the requester's default, 4G).

nestedVirt.description: The VM must run VMs of its own; only a bidder whose offering sets nestedVirt is asked.

tunnels.description: Guest ports the requester reaches over a tunnel transport. Tags are unique within the contract.

guestTools.description: Tools the bidder installs on the guest from its own downloads. socialweb-computer is the bidder's own running binary, linux/amd64 bidders only, installed as /usr/local/bin/socialweb-computer.

tag.description: A DNS-1123 label naming the tunnel.

server.description: The opentunnel server; absent means the requester's default.

transport.description: opentunnel (the default) gives an https URL; webrtc gives a datachannel to the guest agent.

shell.description: A web shell served on the tunnel's port; its token arrives through the contract's secrets bundle, never here.

envFile.description: The guest path of the shell's env file; absent means /etc/wootty/wootty.env.

agent.description: An atirc agent on the guest, started on demand; its token arrives through the contract's secrets bundle, never here.

envFile.description: The guest path of the agent's env file; absent means /etc/atirc/atirc.env.

association.description: A requester the guest runs: after the accept the requester writes a contract-scoped com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.association naming subject and puts its at-uri#cid into the secrets bundle at refFile.

subject.description: The repo DID of the requester the guest runs, when it is known before the RFP.

fromGuest.description: The subject is the DID the guest reports in a compute.events.guest.requesterDid event; set instead of subject.

refFile.description: The guest path of the ref file, under /etc/socialweb-computer/; absent means /etc/socialweb-computer/association-ref.

endedAt.description: Set once, when the deployment ends; the record is kept and an ended record is never live again.

recentEnded.description: Newest first; the oldest drops off. The records themselves are kept.

writer.description: A public label of the kcp that runs it: page:<origin host>, ios, gateway:<host>, cli.
